rdfs:label: summaryMap
rdfs:comment: Language-tagged variants of an ActivityStreams Object's `summary` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised summary strings.
notes: On the fediverse, `summary` is also used as the content warning / spoiler text — `summaryMap` lets that warning be translated alongside the post body. Pair with `contentMap` so the visible warning matches the language of the content the user will reveal.

examples.title: A Note with localised content warning

urn:solid:contentMap.en: I cannot believe what just happened…
urn:solid:contentMap.fr: Je n'arrive pas à croire ce qui vient de se passer…
